name: workflow_generator
summary: Reads a workflow_card_v0 JSON, emits up to 7 semantically-equivalent surfaces (Streamlit proto, Godot scene/.gd/.cpp, Blender headless, SpriteForge manifest, ComfyUI workflow JSON). All emitted files carry the same card_crystal in their header — cryptographic proof of semantic equivalence.
engine_pattern: Pure Python (no Jinja). Each surface is a generator function: card_dict → file content string. card_crystal = blake3(canonical_card_json). Same card → same crystal → same bytes (modulo optional nano text-gen).

env_vars.CC_NANO_MODEL: Ollama model for description text-gen (default qwen2.5:0.5b — 397MB, fast)

outbound_calls: task_queue.TaskQueue (nano text-gen via Ollama pool — optional, --no-nano disables)

determinism.with_nano: card-driven content is deterministic; nano-generated descriptions vary (qwen 0.5b best-effort)
determinism.without_nano: byte-for-byte deterministic — same card_crystal always produces same files

guarantees: All emitted surfaces share the SAME card_crystal in their header — verifiable equivalence
Streamlit + Blender + SpriteForge + ComfyUI outputs parse as valid Python/JSON
Re-running on an unchanged card produces identical bytes (no nano) or near-identical (nano)
Failed nano text-gen falls back to card.summary — never blocks generation
usage_example: python3 core/lib/workflow_generator.py generate studio/assets/_workflows/<card>.json --target all\n# or one surface:\npython3 core/lib/workflow_generator.py generate <card> --target comfyui
